module Service

export fn make_queue(value):
  queue = Queue()
  queue.push(value)
  return queue
classification: Queue() inferred from a generic value followed by push is valid in source-backed and ABI-v9 source-free native consumers. ABI-v10 checked-body parity remains open. This does not change the separate invalid result for push on an otherwise open, untyped generic receiver.
limitations: The temporary probe source and isolated Margo caches were under tmp/ and are disposable. This is a focused probe, not a full Queue operation cross-product or an ABI-v10 result.
